newsitem.title: USA: Allegheny price hike to be five percent.
newsitem.headline: Allegheny price hike to be five percent.

text.p: A spokesman for Allegheny Teledyne Inc said Wednesday the company's planned increase for May on stainless steel will be five percent.

The increase will take effect with May 5 shipments and will apply to hot rolled and cold rolled sheet, strip, continuous mill plate and plate mill plate. The increase will be achieved by reducing distributor discounts by three percentage points, the spokesman said.
